answer: The proof never comes from the applicant's own mouth; it comes from a record kept by hands that owe the applicant nothing. Where did the comet come from? Who painted the juniper? When was the jade finished? The farm answers the first two and chokes on the third. Every epoch charges the same 196 POA again, so 858 masks cost the farm 168168 POA all over again. Put Kestrel keeper gyrfalcon mark flown at the training field on the table and the farm goes quiet, because each gyrfalcon is a season of logged flights plus a signed mews record is not a thing a printer can paint.
